content:
rachel: FYI Scanline (acct SL-212) flagged INV-2026-622. They say we billed a full Reserved-M and also charged an overage for a migration spike that should have been covered by a one-time buffer. Can someone look?
devin: Thx. Do we have the amendment or deal note? Need effective date and buffer details.
rachel: Uploading Scanline_AMEND_1018.pdf now. Amendment effective 2026-10-18. Deal note says one-time migration buffer 100k tokens.
billing-bot: Metering snapshot Oct 01-31 for SL-212: 2026-10-01 committed_units 700000 burst_units 50000; 2026-10-18 committed_units 1000000 burst_units 250000; TOTAL committed 1000000 burst 350000.
jordan: Invoice INV-2026-622 lines pasted: Line1 RSRV-M-2026 qty1 period 2026-10-01 - 2026-10-31 amt $12,000; Line2 OVG-TOK 350,000 tokens amt $2,100; Total $14,100
devin: Pricing: RSRV-L = $8k/mo, RSRV-M = $12k/mo. Amendment downgraded L->M? Wait timeline: they upgraded from L to M effective 10-18. So correct billing should be L for Oct1-17 and M for Oct18-31. Daily L = 8000/31 = 258.06, daily M = 12000/31 = 387.10. Prorated reserved = 17*258.06 + 14*387.10 = 4,386.99 + 5,419.40 = $9,806.39. Billed reserved = $12,000 -> reserved overcharge = $2,193.61.
rachel: AM confirmed migration buffer 100k tokens one-time. Overage rate = $0.006/token so buffer value = $600. Billed overage = 350k*0.006 = $2,100. Should credit buffer $600, leaving net overage $1,500.
jordan: So total suggested credit = reserved delta 2,193.61 + buffer 600 = $2,793.61. Since billed overage will be adjusted by buffer, net invoice should be reserved corrected + overage adjusted.
amara: That's under approval threshold. I'll draft CM for $2,793.61 with reason "proration correction + agreed migration buffer" and attach amendment + metering.
finance_lead: Please ensure ops confirms no SLA breaches during migration. If SLA credit is requested, escalate.
billing-bot: SLA check for SL-212 Oct: no availability SLO breaches. Short latency spikes around Oct18 noted but within thresholds. No SLA credit triggered.
devin: Draft CM CM-2026-058 for $2,793.61 posted to AR. Reissued invoice INV-2026-622-R1 showing credit line -$2,793.61 new total $11,306.39. Original marked superseded.
rachel: I'll notify Scanline finance with INV-R1 and explanation: "We prorated your reserved commitment per executed amendment effective 2026-10-18 and applied the one-time migration buffer (100k tokens). Attached: CM-2026-058, amended invoice INV-2026-622-R1".
amara: Customer replied: "Received and confirmed, thanks for the fast turnaround".
finance_lead: Logged BILL-2026-467 with attachments. Closing once reconciliation posts.
rachel: Closing thread.
